But the revealing factor showing that staff aren't in fact too interested in their patience is how the staff will park in the resident parking of the buildings next to the surgery every. Single. Day.
The surgery has a car park and there is a car park behind the church a 2 min walk away.

Other than basic respect, it's a problem because it cause for residents to then have to park on the road, which means that then patience trying to access to surgery park all over the place - drop kerbs and on the pavement which makes life absolute HELL for wheelchair users, who live in the housing on the court. I watched an elderly lady in her wheelchair get stuck in the mud because she had to pass through a garden because of stupid parking.

Daily my neighbour who use wheelchairs have to use the road to go about their daily lives because pavements are unaccessible.

I literally watched a grey wolkswagen park up in the resident car park when there was still plenty of spaces around and a staff member come out and walk into the surgery.

The surgery is directly contributing to putting its patience at risk for occupying resident parking.

This lack of respect for rules and people around you reflects in your receptionists attitude

I would advise to go elsewhere. And if the staff and the surgery have any pride, park where you are supposed to.",null,[0,160]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pKdFVtMDVWMUZEZEU5Wk9UZGlhVXRHU0V4T1gyYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xbc1ab3b818b69bdb!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOjJtUm05V1FDdE9ZOTdiaUtGSExOX2c%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pKdFVtMDVWMUZEZEU5Wk9UZGlhVXRHU0V4T1gyYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwinkIaogbiTAxVPLGMBHZWuHyMQoykIBygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwinkIaogbiTAxVPLGMBHZWuHyMQ0pMFCAUoAQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUZyT0RKZlgxOWZSV2hCTFZKUFUyTjRTMUZHVVdkb2JXcHdSVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpWYTBOYVdrMWljMGRWV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21Jek1VTkZaV0ZpUW10cWNGVkZhMlJmVjNSdk1rRRAB",["0x0:0xbc1ab3b818b69bdb",null,1758276754259404,1758276754259404,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/103483460737420096033/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["lena hughes","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLEAv8lxPC0Qc_GNiGz0bLZbM5J0O4o6TldIHqRA62EaEFSbw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/103483460737420096033?hl=en"],"103483460737420096033",null,6,0,null,[0,3,1],0,["6 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwinkIaogbiTAxVPLGMBHZWuHyMQ7LoGCAkoAA"]]]],null,"6 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I had to take one of my non verbal children to the doctors and he always melts down when we have to wait in the reception area, he’s big so he can hurt himself or others. This receptionist frequently hangs up, within seconds of saying the line is bad. I say frequently,  I don't need to use the service that often,  but each time I do, if I get through to them,  there is always a line issue, which I never get with any of the others, who are always polite and courteous. It's very frustrating to have to call again and wait for another 20 or so minutes at the back of the queue. Despite the apparent line issues,  when you do speak to this one receptionist, they are quite standoffish. It's that feeling that you get when you're in the wrong and you are being unreasonable for utilisation of an already crippled NHS service. All other staff are nice and personable. If you do speak with this person,  you'll know who it is. I know they're only human,  but so are we, and generally, people utilising their services are doing so at a stressful time of their life,  through personal health issues or that of a loved one. If you can't be empathetic,  then maybe it's time for a change of I was very specific, but she was going over other stuff about blood tests I'd already had and discussed with the doctor weeks ago rather than checking what I'd asked for straight away.

She finally went into the computer and told me the date I'd booked and seemed okay after but my general feedback is that the receptionists and doctors seem to get the wrong end of the stick when you are communicating something with them over the phone and have a tendency to turn it on you, as I'd had the same experience with a doctor over the phone previously.
